requirements.quote: Ethereum NFT raffle; immutable factory, ERC-1167 clones with immutable implementation.
requirements.checkable: The implemented Ethereum smart-contract system conducts a raffle whose prize is an NFT.

requirements.quote: Ethereum NFT raffle; immutable factory, ERC-1167 clones with immutable implementation.
requirements.checkable: The factory's deployed logic cannot be replaced or upgraded after deployment.

requirements.quote: Ethereum NFT raffle; immutable factory, ERC-1167 clones with immutable implementation.
requirements.checkable: Raffle instances deployed by the factory use ERC-1167 minimal-proxy runtime semantics.

requirements.quote: Ethereum NFT raffle; immutable factory, ERC-1167 clones with immutable implementation.
requirements.checkable: Each clone's implementation target is fixed when deployed and cannot subsequently change.

requirements.quote: One entry costs 1,000,000 units of canonical six-decimal USDC.
requirements.checkable: Purchasing n entries costs exactly n multiplied by 1,000,000 quote-token base units.

requirements.quote: One entry costs 1,000,000 units of canonical six-decimal USDC.
requirements.checkable: The accepted quote and payment token is the canonical USDC contract, not a substitute token.

requirements.quote: One entry costs 1,000,000 units of canonical six-decimal USDC.
requirements.checkable: Quote-token accounting uses six-decimal base units, making 1,000,000 units one whole USDC.

requirements.quote: One purchase mints a transferable ERC721 ticket representing a contiguous inclusive range.
requirements.checkable: Every successful purchase mints one ticket token.

requirements.quote: One purchase mints a transferable ERC721 ticket representing a contiguous inclusive range.
requirements.checkable: Each minted ticket implements ERC721 ownership, approval, and transfer semantics.

requirements.quote: One purchase mints a transferable ERC721 ticket representing a contiguous inclusive range.
requirements.checkable: A ticket's ownership can be transferred through ERC721 transfer paths.

requirements.quote: One purchase mints a transferable ERC721 ticket representing a contiguous inclusive range.
requirements.checkable: Each ticket stores or deterministically identifies the entry-range endpoints represented by that ticket.

requirements.quote: One purchase mints a transferable ERC721 ticket representing a contiguous inclusive range.
requirements.checkable: Every entry index between a ticket's range endpoints belongs to that ticket, with no gaps.

requirements.quote: One purchase mints a transferable ERC721 ticket representing a contiguous inclusive range.
requirements.checkable: Both endpoints of a ticket's represented entry range are included in the ticket's entries.

requirements.quote: Exactly one ERC721 prize is escrowed atomically at creation.
requirements.checkable: Each successfully created raffle has exactly one prize NFT, never zero or multiple prizes.

requirements.quote: Exactly one ERC721 prize is escrowed atomically at creation.
requirements.checkable: The escrowed prize is identified and transferred using ERC721 semantics.

requirements.quote: Exactly one ERC721 prize is escrowed atomically at creation.
requirements.checkable: The specified prize enters escrow before the raffle-creation operation returns successfully.

requirements.quote: Exactly one ERC721 prize is escrowed atomically at creation.
requirements.checkable: Raffle creation and prize escrow succeed or revert together, leaving neither a partial raffle nor a partial transfer.

requirements.quote: Reserve met awards NFT and 95% sponsor / 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: A reserve-met result allocates the escrowed NFT as the winning ticket's prize.

requirements.quote: Reserve met awards NFT and 95% sponsor / 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: Reserve-met proceeds allocate exactly 95% to the sponsor, subject to the specified rounding rule.

requirements.quote: Reserve met awards NFT and 95% sponsor / 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: Reserve-met proceeds allocate exactly 5% to the treasury, subject to the specified rounding rule.

requirements.quote: Reserve missed awards 80% gross to winner, 15% sponsor, 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: A reserve-missed outcome allocates exactly 80% of gross proceeds to the winner, subject to the specified rounding rule.

requirements.quote: Reserve missed awards 80% gross to winner, 15% sponsor, 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: A reserve-missed outcome allocates exactly 15% of gross proceeds to the sponsor, subject to the specified rounding rule.

requirements.quote: Reserve missed awards 80% gross to winner, 15% sponsor, 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: A reserve-missed outcome allocates exactly 5% of gross proceeds to the treasury, subject to the specified rounding rule.

requirements.quote: Refund outcome pays 100% per entry and returns prize.
requirements.checkable: Each refunded entry is entitled to its full 1,000,000-unit purchase price without a deduction.

requirements.quote: Refund outcome pays 100% per entry and returns prize.
requirements.checkable: A refund outcome makes the escrowed prize returnable to the party from whom it was escrowed.

requirements.quote: Rounding is floor on aggregate protocol fee; remainder must be allocated without loss.
requirements.checkable: The protocol fee is calculated once from the applicable aggregate amount rather than from separately rounded per-entry or per-ticket fees.

requirements.quote: Rounding is floor on aggregate protocol fee; remainder must be allocated without loss.
requirements.checkable: Any fractional result of the aggregate protocol-fee calculation is rounded down to whole token units.

requirements.quote: Rounding is floor on aggregate protocol fee; remainder must be allocated without loss.
requirements.checkable: All units excluded by fee rounding are assigned to defined payouts so total allocations equal the full distributable amount.

requirements.quote: No administrator, mutable configuration or upgrade.
requirements.checkable: No address has an administrator role or an administrator-only control path.

requirements.quote: No administrator, mutable configuration or upgrade.
requirements.checkable: All behavioral configuration is fixed at creation, with no setter or other post-creation mutation path.

requirements.quote: No administrator, mutable configuration or upgrade.
requirements.checkable: Neither the factory nor raffle clones expose an implementation replacement or other logic-upgrade path.

requirements.quote: Request window [sale end, end+2days); callback accepted strictly before request timestamp+2days.
requirements.checkable: A request is rejected before sale end and is time-eligible beginning exactly at sale end.

requirements.quote: Request window [sale end, end+2days); callback accepted strictly before request timestamp+2days.
requirements.checkable: A request is time-eligible only while the timestamp is less than sale end plus two days and is rejected at or after that upper bound.

requirements.quote: Request window [sale end, end+2days); callback accepted strictly before request timestamp+2days.
requirements.checkable: A callback is accepted only when its timestamp is strictly less than the request timestamp plus two days, excluding the exact deadline.

requirements.quote: Refunds open at deadline.
requirements.checkable: Refund operations become available from the applicable deadline inclusively and remain unavailable before it.

requirements.quote: Callback records result only.
requirements.checkable: A valid callback persists the returned result in raffle state.

requirements.quote: Callback records result only.
requirements.checkable: Callback execution performs no settlement, claim consumption, payout, or asset delivery beyond recording the result.

requirements.quote: Settlement is permissionless, storage-only; redemption requires current ticket owner, burns claim atomically, and must revert all effects on delivery failure.
requirements.checkable: Any caller can invoke settlement once its state preconditions hold, without owner, sponsor, or administrator authorization.

requirements.quote: Settlement is permissionless, storage-only; redemption requires current ticket owner, burns claim atomically, and must revert all effects on delivery failure.
requirements.checkable: Settlement only updates internal outcome and accounting state and performs no token or NFT delivery or untrusted external call.

requirements.quote: Settlement is permissionless, storage-only; redemption requires current ticket owner, burns claim atomically, and must revert all effects on delivery failure.
requirements.checkable: Redemption succeeds only when the caller is the ticket's current ERC721 owner at execution time.

requirements.quote: Settlement is permissionless, storage-only; redemption requires current ticket owner, burns claim atomically, and must revert all effects on delivery failure.
requirements.checkable: Every successful redemption burns or otherwise irreversibly consumes its ticket claim so it cannot be redeemed again.

requirements.quote: Settlement is permissionless, storage-only; redemption requires current ticket owner, burns claim atomically, and must revert all effects on delivery failure.
requirements.checkable: Claim consumption, redemption accounting, and asset delivery occur in one all-or-nothing transaction.

requirements.quote: Settlement is permissionless, storage-only; redemption requires current ticket owner, burns claim atomically, and must revert all effects on delivery failure.
requirements.checkable: Any delivery failure reverts the entire redemption, restoring the claim and every state or accounting change.

requirements.quote: Sponsor and treasury can claim independently after settlement.
requirements.checkable: Once settlement has occurred, the sponsor can claim its complete allocated entitlement.

requirements.quote: Sponsor and treasury can claim independently after settlement.
requirements.checkable: Once settlement has occurred, the treasury can claim its complete allocated entitlement.

requirements.quote: Sponsor and treasury can claim independently after settlement.
requirements.checkable: Either sponsor or treasury can claim without the other claiming first, and one claim does not consume or block the other's entitlement.

requirements.quote: Never move assets between raffle clones.
requirements.checkable: No execution path transfers or reallocates token or NFT assets from one raffle clone to another.

requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies; arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.
requirements.checkable: The quote token occupies the trusted side of the declared boundary, with no attacker-selected token granted equivalent trust.

requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies; arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.
requirements.checkable: All quote-token operations use a pinned canonical dependency that cannot be replaced with another token contract.

requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies; arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.
requirements.checkable: The Chainlink wrapper occupies the trusted side of the declared boundary, with no attacker-selected caller granted equivalent callback authority.

requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies; arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.
requirements.checkable: Randomness requests and callbacks use a pinned canonical Chainlink wrapper dependency that cannot be replaced.

requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies; arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.
requirements.checkable: Raffle creation does not require a trusted prize-contract allowlist and can use an arbitrary contract through the required ERC721 interface.

requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies; arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.
requirements.checkable: No safety invariant depends on a prize contract behaving honestly; reverting or reentrant prize-contract behavior is contained.

requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies; arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.
requirements.checkable: No safety invariant depends on a ticket recipient behaving honestly; any recipient callback or delivery failure is safely contained.

requirements.quote: Frontend discovery is advisory; transaction decisions must reread current chain state.
requirements.checkable: Frontend discovery or indexed data is treated as non-authoritative and cannot alone determine transaction-critical state.

requirements.quote: Frontend discovery is advisory; transaction decisions must reread current chain state.
requirements.checkable: Before making a transaction decision, the frontend rereads all decision-critical values from current on-chain state rather than relying on cached discovery data.
